chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 38: Ji Ning's Water-Fire Lotus Breakthrough & Tie Muzhan's Hunt
chapter_meta_description: Exhausted by the pond, Ji Ning watches lotus leaves spin and unlocks a stunning Dao epiphany—the birth of the Water-Fire Lotus! But Tie Muzhan closes in...
og_title: The Lotus of Water and Fire Blooms!
og_description: A wolf is shredded by a natural law. Ji Ning sits in harmony. A furious Tie Muzhan arrives to ruin the perfect scene.

twitter_description: A simple evening by the pond turns into a cultivation miracle as Ji Ning grasps a new True Meaning. His enemies are not impressed.
